name: Suvendu Adhikari
role: Chief Minister of West Bengal (since May 2026); MLA for Bhabanipur; Leader of the Opposition in the West Bengal Assembly (2021–2026)
summary: Adhikari moved from the Trinamool Congress to the BJP in 2020 and now leads the state government. His public statements prioritise enforcement against alleged illegal migration, legal protections for Hindu refugees, cattle protection and a planned uniform civil code with anti-conversion laws, alongside industrial investment courting.
